purpose: Conditioning of GeoTransolver's global-context projector versus the magnitude of the freestream (drive) vector it receives. Reproduces the independent audit's finding (audit.md item 1) on the production projector dimensions with fixed random weights (seed 42), untrained, CPU float32.
why_it_matters: The surface recipes feed GeoTransolver (conf/model/geotransolver_surface.yaml: global_embedding: global_data.U_inf) and Transolver (transolver_surface.yaml: fx.source: global_data.U_inf) the PHYSICAL freestream velocity, while ISLA receives the unit direction U_inf_dir (isla_surface.yaml: drive: global_data.U_inf_dir). The dataset pipelines nondimensionalize field values and coordinates but not this global input. HiLiftAeroML's freestream is 2679.5 in/s (dataset ref_values, revision bbec30bcfc6103309c1375c5228b3ad0a586bfaf); DrivAerML's is 38.9 m/s. The same physical U_inf is consumed by the frozen cluster snapshots used for every HiLift and DrivAerML baseline lane (verified 2026-09-08 in $T/recipe/conf/model/).
instrument: GeoTransolver(out_dim=4, functional_dim=6, geometry_dim=3, global_dim=3, n_layers=2, n_hidden=256, n_head=8, slice_num=256, use_te=False, include_local_features=False); p = model.context_builder.global_tokenizer; x,_ = p.project_input_onto_slices(drive); prob = softmax(p.in_project_slice(x) / p.temperature.clamp(0.5, 5)); effective slices = exp(entropy(prob)) per head; context max = |p(drive)|.max(). Script: probes/condition.py (audit.md reproduction block).
reading: At unit magnitude the untrained projector spreads each head over roughly 200 of 256 slices; at HiLiftAeroML's physical magnitude every head collapses onto one slice and the context vector's largest entry is about 1500. This is a verified conditioning difference between what the baselines and ISLA receive. It is NOT evidence that it explains the trained small-data gap: DrivAerML's 38.9 m/s also collapses the projector (1.0-3.8 slices) and GeoTransolver still leads ISLA there. The discriminating experiment is the unit-drive training control (notebook #sec-nb-udrv-prereg): GeoTransolver and Transolver with U_inf_dir in place of U_inf, same cases, seeds, budget and learning rates.
verified_by: coordinator, 2026-09-08, torch CPU; matches audit.md to the printed precision
